detail.zh: 记录项目结构、常用命令和约定；检查生成的文件，再决定是否采用。配置存在不证明后续遵守。
detail.en: Record project structure, commands and conventions. Inspect the file before adopting it; its presence does not prove later compliance.

title.en: Review context before a new task

detail.zh: 确认哪些历史信息仍相关，再决定继续会话或开启新会话。这里不估算节省费用或质量变化。
detail.en: Check which history is still relevant before continuing or opening a new session. No cost or quality improvement is measured here.

tips.source: 官方计费文档 + 社区共识

detail.zh: 让 AI 先列步骤和待确认项，审阅后再决定执行。检查改动，不保证减少返工。
detail.en: Ask for steps and open questions, then decide whether to proceed. Inspect changes; reduced rework is not guaranteed.

tips.source: 官方文档 + 社区实践

detail.zh: 检查工具日志是否提供缓存读取量。缓存条件和计费依模型及供应商而异，不推定折扣。
detail.en: Check whether tool logs include cache reads. Cache conditions and billing vary by model and provider; no discount is assumed.

detail.zh: 先整理结论和待办，检查摘要是否完整，再压缩或开新会话。
detail.en: Summarize conclusions and next steps, check the summary, then compact or open a new session.

tips.source: 官方文档 + 社区共识

title.zh: 重复失败后重新检查条件

detail.zh: 检查失败原因，缩小任务或补充相关信息，再决定下一次尝试。
detail.en: Inspect the failure, narrow the task or add relevant information, then decide on another attempt.

why.zh: 选择一项已学能力，在另一个任务中练习。
why.en: Choose a learned capability to practise in another task.

prompt.zh: 在另一个适合的任务中再次使用这项能力，完成后检查新记录。
prompt.en: Use this capability again in another suitable task, then check the new records.

zh: 在适合的任务中阅读并使用下面的指令。
完成后检查新记录；没有记录时只能自报尝试。
en: Read and use the prompt in a suitable task.
Check new records afterwards; without coverage, report only a personal attempt.

expected_signal.zh: 检查对应能力的新结构化记录；配置存在不证明使用成功。
expected_signal.en: Look for a new structured capability record; configuration does not prove successful use.

limitations.zh: 不验证回答正确性或 shell 测试成功；日志支持依工具和格式而异。
limitations.en: Does not verify answer correctness or shell test success; log support varies by tool and format.
